title: Carrier Supplement Money Pending, Set against Overdue Reconstruction Draws
content:
The company does not charge for carrier money the insured is still waiting for, as the base overdue rule carries no charge on carrier-funded draws while their funds are pending. On a past-due customer-funded draw of a Reconstruction contract, dwelling supplement money the carrier has not yet paid is therefore set against the balance the overdue draw charge is figured on.

**Rule.** The supplement money set against the balance follows the carrier's supplement decisions:

- when the claim file carries dwelling supplement approvals not yet matched by dwelling supplement payments, it is the approved amount not yet paid;
- when it carries no such unpaid approval and the dwelling supplement request with the highest supplement number has no supplement approval naming it, it is that request's requested amount;
- otherwise no supplement money is set against it.

When a dwelling supplement request other than the one with the highest supplement number still has no supplement approval naming it, the carrier has decided the supplements out of order and the charge is handed to a human representative as not covered by policy.

The supplement requests, approvals and payments are those of the linked claim file kept under Insurance Claim Services.

## Reading the claim file

| Dwelling supplement approvals compared with dwelling supplement payments | Highest-numbered dwelling supplement request | Set against the balance |
|---|---|---|
| approvals exceed payments | any | approved amount not yet paid |
| fully paid, or none | has no approval naming it | that request's requested amount |
| fully paid, or none | has an approval naming it, and so has every earlier request | nothing |
| fully paid, or none | no dwelling supplement request filed | nothing |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

- Supplement approvals of $6,000.00 and supplement payments of $4,500.00: $1,500.00 is set against the balance.
- Every approval paid; supplements 1 and 2 approved; supplement 3, requesting $2,750.00, has no approval yet: $2,750.00.
- Supplement 3 approved but supplement 2 still undecided: the carrier has decided out of order, and the charge goes to a human representative as not covered by policy.
